changelog:
Version 0.1.0 (Initial Release)

- Introduced a calculation assistant for one-dimensional linear tolerance stack-ups, supporting both Worst Case (WC) and Root Sum Square (RSS) methods.
- Calculates cumulative tolerances, verifies assembly gaps/interference, and identifies major contributors to tolerance overruns.
- Designed for dimensional/process/design engineers; supports both structured data input and stepwise guidance.
- Provides detailed calculation logic, comparison to requirements, simple tolerance allocation suggestions, and generates plain text and Markdown reports.
- Clearly defined use cases, input requirements, capability boundaries, and step-by-step workflow.
summary: 尺寸链/公差叠加计算助手；支持极值法（Worst Case）与统计平方和方法（RSS）计算累积公差，验证装配间隙/干涉，定位超差风险。面向尺寸/工艺工程师。
